scripts.build: curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && curl -L https://github.com/rustwasm/wasm-pack/releases/download/v0.13.0/wasm-pack-v0.13.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz | tar -xz && ./wasm-pack-v0.13.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir www/pkg
scripts.dev: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir www/pkg && npx serve www
